name: Ray Co., Ltd.
summary: RAY Co., Ltd. specializes in delivering x-ray diagnostic tools for the dental sector. Their comprehensive product lineup features the RAYSACN Series, RAYios, RAYFace, RAYDENT Microscan, and the RIO Series, in addition to RAYDENT designer and tray, RAYSmiler, RAYDENT Studio, and the RAYDENT Mill 4X and 5X. They also supply related consumables. Founded in 2004, the company's main operations are based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
